if game.PlaceId~=130526233138543 then print("unsupported game")return end

-- auto tag everyone
-- tags u first, then tags everyone

local rteam = {}

local hrp = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart

local function start()
    for _, plr in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if plr.Team.Name == "Blue" then
        hrp.CFrame = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
    end
    task.wait(.2)

end
end

if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Team.Name ~= "Red" then
    for _, plr in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr.Team.Name == "Red" then
            table.insert(rteam, plr)
            print("debug: "..plr.Name.." is on red team")
        end
    end
end

if #rteam > 0 then
    hrp.CFrame = rteam[math.random(1,#rteam)].Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
    task.wait(1)
    start()
else
    task.wait(1)
    start()
end
